Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on November 3, 2025. I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread with that date.

Two sources support it. Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2, 2025 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap note gives the same date.

Her recap also says she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 3 as the official date and Nov 22 if the tracker needs operational coverage.
